title: P2 ICP impedance-map record (p2_impedance_record_v1)
description: Generated by docs/experiments/hall_icp/p2_impedance_map/build_p2_impedance_prep.py from the reducer's field tuples; complex values are [re, im]. Forbidden keys (any depth): names starting with P_plasma, P_absorbed_plasma

data_class.description: measured | synthetic_test (synthetic output is labelled SYNTHETIC_TEST_DATA_NOT_EVIDENCE)

calibration_set_id.description: id of the calibration set used (must be supplied to the reducer)

f_Hz.description: drive frequency; must equal the calibration frequency

Z0_ohm.description: reference impedance; must equal the calibration Z0

reference_planes.description: keys coupler_powers (RP-CPL), coupler_reflection (RP-CPL, if complex reflection recorded), vi_probe (RP-VI); values in RP-GEN, RP-CPL, RP-MIN, RP-ANT, RP-VI
reference_planes.x-reference-plane: declares the plane of each measurement

coupler.description: P_sens_fwd_W, P_sens_ref_W (sensor readings, W), power_sensor_cal_id, reflection_raw ([re, im] raw reflection ratio or null)

vi_probe.description: V_raw, I_raw ([re, im]), vi_cal_id; null when not installed

factors.description: fields: P_RF_setpoint_W, mdot_hall_anode_mg_s, mdot_icp_dedicated_mg_s, gas_mode, gas, p_icp_source_Pa, p_chamber_Pa, hall_state, V_collector_V, I_collector_A, P_mains_in_W (explicit null where not applicable; P_mains_in_W is GROUND/FACILITY_ONLY)

plasma_state.description: lit, mode (UNLIT, E, H, UNCERTAIN), optical_signal_V

sweep.description: sweep_id, direction (up, down, reference, single), index

temperatures_K.description: antenna, dielectric, collector, match, cables, probe

cold_reference_id.description: id of the cold-antenna reference in the calibration set

p1_stable_region_ref.description: required non-PENDING reference for HOT_MAP records

power_labels.description: optional; any label naming plasma power is refused

calibration_set.description: schema 'p2_calibration_set_v1': power_sensors {id: {CF_fwd, CF_ref, certificate}}; coupler {cal_id, plane RP-CPL, phase_calibrated, e00, e11, e10e01}; two_ports {line (RP-CPL->RP-MIN), match_states {tuning_state_id: two-port RP-MIN->RP-ANT}} with S11, S12, S21, S22, cal_id, phase_calibrated; vi_probe {cal_id, phase_calibrated, k_V, k_I, fixture_abcd, fixture_from_plane RP-VI, fixture_to_plane RP-ANT, amplitude_convention}; loss_bounds {id: {loss_fraction_max, source, evidence_class}}; cold_references {id: {R_cold_ohm, source_record_id, evidence_class, antenna_temperature_K}}; antenna_current_probe {cal_id, k_mag, certificate} | null
